title: 第7章 药师之职有病即有药第8章 随性之人的随性之举
slug: 大罗邪仙苟在剑门当药师
content_zh:
“嗯？”度凌好吃惊，抬头。
西门三丝道：“本姑娘问你，他专程前来，可是有意收你为徒？”
“收我为徒？三小姐为何有如此荒谬的想法？”度凌皱眉道。
西门三丝道：“他明知道你的悟道茶于他没有作用，偏偏还亲自前来，喝茶显然只是借口，他真正的目的，应该还是看上你了。”
“你想多了！他除了喝杯茶之外，一个多余的字都没提起。”度凌道。
“这就是你傻了！”西门三丝道：“站在他的位置上，怎么可能主动提及收徒？你稍微有一丁点眼力劲，就该看得出来这是多么好的送上门的机会……你难道也没有主动提及？”
度凌轻轻摇头。
西门三丝也是摇头叹息，深度无语：“我其实也知道你这人挺没眼力劲的，但还是低估了你的迟钝，如此千古良机就此错过，真不知道你在这江湖上是怎么混的……”
“你很希望我拜他为师？”度凌道。
“这不废话吗？像他这样的高人，于修行宗门实是最大的资源宝库，剑门若有人得他青睐，于剑门的帮助将是空前的！”西门三丝道：“所以，我个人建议你抽个时间去一趟望江城，专程去拜访下他，若是他稍微有点口气松动，你直接一膝盖跪下去，将生米做成熟饭！千万莫迟疑。相信我，拜他为师，固然是为了剑门，更是为了你自己！”
她的语气很真诚，很急切。
度凌轻轻咳嗽一声：“两位小姐，坐下聊聊如何？你这站着训话，我抬头看你，脖子酸……”
西门三丝也是无语了，如此苦口婆心的劝，这小子貌似还是没上心，有那么点烂泥糊不上墙的感觉。
但西门二丝嫣然一笑，坐下了。
西门三丝也只能坐下……
“这位钟大儒来剑门做甚？”度凌转换了话题。
“正好叫你得知！”西门三丝道：“十位三代弟子被人破了丹田气海，修行道上基本宣告无药可救，这位杏林圣手出手，以‘定缺三针’，将他们从绝境中拉回！这……就是绝代医术于修行道上的神奇效能，你若……”
度凌直接打断：“这十位弟子，是谁击破的丹田气海，又为何要击破丹田气海？”
“还能有谁？用脚趾头想想也知道，只能是裂川谷的人！”西门三丝道：“他们与我剑门百年对立，妄图一举清除掉我们第三代最强的弟子，让剑门后继无人。”
这就是宗门之间最残酷的对抗法则。

不仅仅拼本代，还拼后代子弟。
后代子弟出色，宗门才有源源不断的新鲜血液注入，才会不断地攀登更高的巅峰。
反之，后代子弟断层，再辉煌的宗门，也会逐渐走向没落。
度凌轻轻点头：“既然知道是他们干的，长老们打算怎么报复？”
“这……”西门三丝道：“这不是你一个药师该关心的事儿吧？”
“你可知道何为药师？”度凌淡淡一笑：“所谓药师，奉行的宗旨就是有病就得有药。十个弟子丹田被废，是病，导致他们丹田被废的宗门势力，却是病根！治病不除根，后患无穷也！”
西门三丝沉默了……
她懂了度凌的意思。
裂川谷既然已经有了针对剑门年轻一代的想法，并不顾江湖规矩予以实施，那就真的后患无穷。
今日有杏林圣手出现，将十位天骄的修行路断路重续。
明日呢？
明日剑门任何一个天骄出门，都有可能遭到对方的针对。
谁能保证，次次都有这么好的命？
content_en:
"Huh?" Du Ling looked up in surprise.
Ximen Sansi said: "I want to ask you, he came here specially, but he intends to accept you as his disciple?"
"Accept me as your disciple? Why does Miss Third have such ridiculous ideas?" Du Ling frowned.
Ximen Sansi said: "He clearly knows that your Enlightenment Tea has no effect on him, yet he still comes in person. Drinking tea is obviously just an excuse. His real purpose is probably to fall in love with you."
"You're thinking too much! He didn't mention a single extra word except for a cup of tea." Du Ling said.
"That's why you are stupid!" Ximen Sansi said: "In his position, how could he take the initiative to mention accepting a disciple? If you had a little bit of discernment, you should have seen what a great opportunity this was... Didn't you also take the initiative to mention it?"
Du Ling shook his head gently.
Ximen Sansi also shook her head and sighed, deeply speechless: "I actually know that you have no eyesight, but I still underestimated your slowness. Such an eternal opportunity has been missed. I really don't know how you got around in this world..."
"You really hope that I will become my teacher?" Du Ling said.
"Isn't this nonsense? An expert like him is actually the biggest treasure house of resources for the cultivation sect. If someone from Jianmen is favored by him, the help from Jianmen will be unprecedented!" Ximen Sansi said: "So, I personally suggest that you take some time to go there. Go to Wangjiang City and pay him a special visit. If he feels a little relieved, just kneel down and cook the rice! Don’t hesitate. Believe me, it’s not just for Jianmen, but also for yourself!”
Her tone was sincere and urgent.
Du Ling coughed lightly: "You two ladies, how about we sit down and chat? You are standing up lecturing me. When I look up at you, my neck feels sore..."
Ximen Sansi was also speechless. After such earnest persuasion, this kid still seemed not to take it seriously.
But Ximen Ersi smiled sweetly and sat down.
Ximen Sansi could only sit down...
"Why did Zhong Daru come to Jianmen?" Du Ling changed the subject.
"Just in time for you to know!" Ximen Sansi said: "Ten third-generation disciples were damaged by someone's Dantian Qi sea, and it was basically declared hopeless on the spiritual path. This Xinglin sage took action and used the 'Three Needles to Determine the Deficiency' to pull them back from the desperate situation! This... is the miraculous effect of peerless medical skills on the spiritual path. If you..."
Du Ling interrupted directly: "Of these ten disciples, who broke through the Dantian Qi sea, and why did they break through the Dantian Qi sea?"
"Who else could it be? Thinking about it with your toes, you know that it can only be people from the Rift River Valley!" Ximen Sansi said: "They have been at odds with our Jianmen Sect for hundreds of years, trying to eliminate our strongest disciples of the third generation in one fell swoop, leaving Jianmen Sect with no successors."
This is the most cruel law of confrontation between sects.
Not only for this generation, but also for future generations.
Only when future generations are outstanding can the sect receive a steady stream of fresh blood, and only then can the sect continue to climb to higher peaks.
On the contrary, if the descendants of the descendants are disconnected, no matter how glorious the sect is, it will gradually decline.
Du Ling nodded slightly: "Now that we know it was them, how do the elders plan to retaliate?"
"This..." Ximen Sansi said: "Isn't this something you, a pharmacist, should be concerned about?"
"Do you know what a pharmacist is?" Du Ling smiled faintly: "The so-called pharmacist's purpose is to provide medicine when there is a disease. The ten disciples' Dantian was destroyed because of the disease, but the sect's power that caused their Dantian to be destroyed is the root of the disease! If the disease is not cured, the root cause will be endless!"
Ximen Sansi was silent...
She understood what Du Ling meant.
Since the Rift Valley has already had an idea for the younger generation of Jianmen and implemented it regardless of the rules of the world, there will be endless troubles.
Today, the Holy Hand of Xinglin appeared and interrupted the cultivation paths of the ten geniuses and restarted them.
What about tomorrow?
Tomorrow any prodigy from Jianmen who goes out may be attacked by the other party.against.
Who can guarantee that I will have such a good life every time?
